audioCaveat: Design says 主增益峰值 <=0.12 without specifying signal vs GainNode parameter/units. Actual master.gain is 1 unmuted; recorded output-signal peak is 0.12731029. Neither a gain parameter nor an output signal should be silently substituted for the other. Concurrent same-type limit has no implementation. Test project remains unchanged.
